text:
Alex: Quick sync — console needs a clear contract for per-model/route SLO panels. Asking for P50/P95/P99, TTFT, and tokens/sec as the canonical metrics. We need a short list of runtime/infra emit fields and an ingestion budget. cc @Sam @Maria @Jordan

Sam: Acknowledged. Runtime can emit route-level histograms + point stats. Proposal: emit `route_id`, `model_id`, `model_variant`, `quant`, `latency_ms_hist` (hdr), `latency_ms_p50`,`latency_ms_p95`,`latency_ms_p99`, `ttft_ms`, `tokens_in_window`, `cpu_gpu_tier`. Is `model_variant` required for dashboards?

Maria: Yes on variant — we want to be able to roll out quantized vs fp metrics separately. Concern: full hdr for every request will blow up ingestion. Suggestion: sample hdrs at 1% and emit point-aggregates (counts/sum/min/max) at 100%. We can compute P50/P95/P99 offline from sampled hdrs + streaming sketch.

Jordan: Ingest cost caveat — if every route emits hdrs per-request we'll exceed quota. Can we do: hdrs for p99 candidates only (sampled), and counters for total tokens and token-rate as a gauge every 10s? Also recommend histogram buckets for TTFT: [0-50,50-200,200-500,500-2000,2000+].

Riley: From Console UX side: dashboard needs per-model tabs + route filter. Panels: latency shape (spark + p50/p95/p99), TTFT trend, tokens/sec heatmap by route. Also want canary rollout overlay (show two variants side-by-side) and a fallback indicator when low-tier model is serving. Do we have an API for linking rollout ids -> model_variant?

Sam: We can add `rollout_id` to emitter meta. Runtime changes required: add `rollout_id` and `model_variant` tags, add a 10s aggregate emission that includes `tokens_in_window` and `requests`. Hdr emission: enable via env var `EMIT_HDR=true` per deployment, default false. Example payload:
```
{
  "route_id": "checkout.client.create",
  "model_id": "redwood-13b-v2",
  "model_variant": "q4_1",
  "rollout_id": "canary-2026-05",
  "latency_ms_p50": 42,
  "latency_ms_p95": 180,
  "latency_ms_p99": 450,
  "ttft_ms": 120,
  "tokens_in_window": 3400,
  "tokens_per_sec": 34.0,
  "cpu_gpu_tier": "a100-40g",
  "sample_rate_hdr": 0.01
}
```

Maria: That payload looks good. For the sampling plan: hdr sampling at 0.01 default, configurable per route. We should include an emitter version field `emitter_v` and a small `schema_checksum` so ingestion can detect mismatches. Also we need backfills for the initial rollout comparison (store both variants as separate time series).

Jordan: I'll run a quick capacity calc: assuming 500 routes, avg 10 req/s per route, aggregate 5k req/s. With 1% hdrs that's 50 hdrs/s — fine. The 10s aggregates (metrics every 10s) are 500 points/s — also ok. But if a customer has bursty spikes we should allow sampling override. I'll add autosample logic into runtime.

Riley: UX followups: I'll mock the per-model page with variant split and a side-by-side p95 delta. Need `rollout_id` and `model_variant` in the query API. Also want a boolean `fallback_active` signal from routing when fallback kicks in.

metrics-bot: New metric registered: `route_ttft_ms` (gauge), `route_tokens_per_sec` (gauge), `route_latency_p{50,95,99}` (gauge). Emitter schema v1.2 published to proto-registry.

Alex: Nice. Action items: Sam -> update runtime emitter to include `rollout_id`, `model_variant`, 10s aggregates, and `emitter_v` by EOD Fri. Maria -> draft sampling guidance + ingestion budget doc by Wed. Jordan -> capacity/cost calc + autosample proposal by Wed. Riley -> dashboard mockups + API query spec by Thu. I'll open a follow-up PR for console panel templates. If no objections, we'll ship emitter v1.2 next week and enable on staging only. :thumbsup:

Sam: Ack, starting emitter patch now.

Maria: Will add sampling examples and a gif for the console docs.

Jordan: I'll post numbers in #eng-infra when done.

Riley: Adding wireframes to the design board.

Alex: Thanks team — we'll do a quick sync on Thu 9am to verify staging signals.
